primaryEvidence.description: The introduction identifies the short Greek recension with Codex Vaticanus and long with Codex Sinaiticus; it discusses them as distinct textual recensions.

The introduction explicitly identifies two long-recension omissions, in Tobit’s instruction(chapter4) and thanksgiving(chapter13), and says a leaf or leaves appear to have been lost from the manuscript. This is not a publisher instruction to read the upper text once for both recensions.
